Presenting a thoughtfully located 200 sq. Yards (Approx. 1800 sq. Ft.) property in greenfields colony, one of faridabads most established, serene, and well-Planned residential townships. Spread across nearly 450 acres of developed residential land, greenfields colony offers a perfect blend of greenery, peaceful surroundings, and exceptional connectivitymaking it one of the most preferred and premium neighbourhoods in the faridabad-Delhi ncr belt.

Strategically positioned near the badarpur border and just 1 km from mathura road, the location offers unmatched access to major parts of delhi ncr. Residents enjoy short travel times, with the property being 15 minutes from gk, saket, kalkaji, jasola, and south delhi, and 30 minutes from cyber city, gurugram. For working professionals commuting to delhi, noida, okhla, nehru place, jasola, mohan estate, or gurgaon, greenfields colony provides the ideal residential balancepeaceful living with excellent urban connectivity.

This 200 sq. Yards property sits in one of the most organised pockets of greenfields, surrounded by modern builder floors, independent houses, and newly developed villas. The plot size is highly adaptable for various construction styleswhether you are planning a 3-Floor + stilt builder floor project, a spacious multi-Family residence, or a contemporary independent villa. The rectangular dimensions allow efficient architectural planning, enabling layouts with large living spaces, bedrooms with attached washrooms, modular kitchens, balconies, stilt parking, and open areas.

Greenfields colony stands out for its wide internal roads, clean surroundings, low-Density living, and an environment enriched with greenery. The locality is well-Known for its peaceful residential atmosphere compared to other congested parts of the ncr, making it especially attractive for families. A number of parks, playgrounds, and open landscaped spaces contribute to the overall beauty and liveability of the neighbourhood. The area enjoys reliable infrastructure, including 247 water supply, strong electricity network, well-Maintained roads, and street lighting.

Daily essentials and conveniences are available within minutes. Residents have access to supermarkets, local markets, pharmacies, banks, atms, cafs, eateries, and service storesall within the colony or in immediate proximity. A number of reputed schools, coaching centres, daycare facilities, and tuition centres operate nearby, making the area extremely child-Friendly. Healthcare facilities, including clinics, multispeciality hospitals, diagnostic centres, and fitness facilities, are just a short drive away.

Connectivity is one of the strongest advantages of this location. The property enjoys easy accessibility to the badarpur metro station, public transportation, autos, cabs, and major road networks that connect faridabad, delhi, noida, and gurugram. The upcoming infrastructure enhancements across faridabad and delhi ncr are further boosting the value and livability of the area.

For investors and builders, greenfields colony has consistently shown strong appreciation due to its location advantages, peaceful environment, and increasing preference for modern builder floors. A 200 sq. Yards plot is an ideal size for generating excellent rental income, resale returns, and long-Term value. Many premium projects developed in the colony attract end-Users who wish to live near south delhi but prefer a more spacious, affordable, and community-Oriented lifestyle.

This property is also suitable for end-Use buyers planning their dream home. The space allows you to design and customise according to your familys requirementswhether you prefer open terraces, large bedrooms, an office space, a puja room, entertainment areas, or a landscaped garden. The flexibility this plot offers makes it a valuable option in a fast-Developing and sought-After neighbourhood.

In summary, this 200 sq. Yards (1800 sq. Ft.) property in greenfields colony, faridabad delivers the perfect combination of:

Peaceful and green residential surroundings

Premium neighbourhood with organised infrastructure

Excellent connectivity to delhi, gurugram, noida, and central faridabad

Strong investment potential and rental opportunity

Ideal plot size for builder floors, villas, or personal use
